content.short: A Cardano Metaverse focused on expansion of the ecosystem through collaborations.
content.description: Ada Realm is a social metaverse project on the Cardano blockchain that allows users to purchase digital real estate called a plot . Those who purchase a plot(s) will have full ownership and can sell/trade them as they please. We are also focused on expanding through collaborations with other projects.
